lines: 16:52:45  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Ravick): Heard, Ravick. Your merchant is his own man and lies outside my hand; I mint no coin and I will not fill a bowl from the air. What is mine to give is this: the caves still hold things worth carrying, there is a door in the north that opens outward, and whatever a man bears through it stays his. Go armed. Come back out.
